repos.description: 24 Lessons, 12 Weeks, Get Started as a Web Developer
repos.summary_zh: 微软官方出品的系统性Web开发入门课程，12周24节课涵盖HTML/CSS/JavaScript核心基础。采用项目驱动教学法，通过生态箱、浏览器扩展等实践项目强化学习效果。支持40+种语言自动化翻译，开源社区协作模式。适合零基础学习者、教育工作者及自学者快速掌握现代Web开发技能。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official 12-week web development curriculum designed for absolute beginners, featuring 24 comprehensive lessons covering HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Employs project-based learning methodology through practical projects including terrariums, browser extensions, and space games. Features automated multi-language translation support for 40+ languages via GitHub Actions. Open-source and community-driven with quizzes, discussions, and assignments. Perfect for aspiring developers, educators, and self-learners seeking structured, hands-on web development training.

repos.summary_zh: emilkowalski/skills 仓库为设计工程师与 AI 智能体提供专业技能库，专注用户界面动画与设计决策优化。基于 Vercel 和 Linear 实战经验，技能帮助 AI 避免缓动函数错误、阴影选择不当等常见品味问题，包含 emil-design-eng 核心指导、动画审查、精确动画词汇及 Apple 流畅运动原则等模块。通过 skills.sh CLI 快速安装，为 AI 代理注入专家品味，是生成精美流畅界面的高效快捷方式。
repos.summary_en: The emilkowalski/skills repository delivers curated skills for design engineers and AI agents to build superior user interfaces with emphasis on animations and design decisions. Drawing from experience at Vercel and Linear, these skills equip agents with professional taste to avoid pitfalls like incorrect easing or suboptimal visual choices. Modules include emil-design-eng for core guidance, strict animation reviews, precise vocabulary, and Apple-inspired motion principles. Installable via the skills.sh CLI, it offers a shortcut to polished, expert-level UI outputs from AI agents.

repos.description: Huashu Design 3.0 · 在 agent 里打一句话，拿回能交付的设计：网页 / App 原型 / 可编辑 PPTX / 动画 / 信息图 · 六个候选挑三个方向 · 84 种带样张的风格库 · 越用越懂你的外观账本与设计体检 · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any agent
repos.summary_zh: 华数设计是一款HTML原生的AI设计技能，可将文本描述直接转化为可交付的生产级设计稿。支持Claude Code等主流AI编程助手，3-30分钟内生成可点击的App原型、演讲幻灯片、60秒动画及信息图。核心亮点包括：20种内置设计哲学与5维评审体系确保专业品质；Motion Design引擎支持时间轴动画与MP4/GIF导出；HTML幻灯片可转为可编辑PPTX；Tweaks面板实现参数化实时调整。无需Figma插件，纯文本交互，输出印刷级排版与跨平台HTML文件。
repos.summary_en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill that transforms text prompts into production-ready deliverables within 3-30 minutes. Compatible with Claude Code and other AI agents, it generates clickable App prototypes, presentation slides, motion graphics, and infographics. Key features include: 20 built-in design philosophies with 5-dimension expert review system; Motion Design engine supporting timeline animation and MP4/GIF export; HTML slides convertible to editable PPTX; Tweaks panel for parametric adjustments. No Figma plugins needed—pure text interface delivers print-quality layouts and cross-platform HTML output.

repos.description: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.
repos.summary_zh: img2threejs 是一个面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude）的开源技能，可将单张参考图像重建为代码生成的程序化 Three.js 3D 模型。它采用多阶段雕刻管道、严格质量门控、细节清单和代理视觉审查，确保比例、材质、细节高保真；Python 脚本处理验证与状态管理，实现令牌高效，输出为动画就绪的 TypeScript 代码（含枢轴、插槽），支持硬表面对象与角色。适用于网页 3D 应用、游戏道具与交互体验，重建方式为代码而非网格或摄影测量。
repos.summary_en: img2threejs is an open-source skill for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude) that reconstructs a single reference image into a code-only, procedural Three.js 3D model. It uses a multi-stage sculpting pipeline with strict quality gates, detail inventory, and agent-vision reviews for high-fidelity proportions, materials, and details. Python stdlib scripts handle validation and state for token efficiency, with the LLM focused on judgment. Outputs are animation-ready TypeScript factories from primitives and shaders, supporting hard-surface objects and characters. Ideal for web 3D apps, game props, and interactive experiences via code reconstruction rather than meshes.

repos.description: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.
repos.summary_zh: OpenMotion 是首个全栈智能体视频生成器，支持上传参考视频或粘贴链接，通过 HTML 编码视频，用自有品牌素材重新创作。内置 Motion.md 格式描述镜头顺序与转场，支持 BYOA/BYOK，集成图像、视频、音乐和语音生成。
repos.summary_en: OpenMotion is the first full-stack agentic video generator. Upload a reference video or paste a social link to recreate it with your own brand kit. Code video with HTML, edit timing in Studio, and render MP4. Features Motion.md format for shot order, timing, and transitions. Supports BYOA/BYOK with 22 local agents and built-in models for images, video, music, and voice.

repos.description: Animated components for design engineers. 150+ free shadcn/ui components, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 为设计工程师打造的UI组件库，提供92+可复制的AI智能体模式与4个全栈模板。基于Tailwind CSS开发，完全兼容Shadcn，支持一键复制、Next.js导出或v0导入，快速构建可访问的定制化界面。
repos.summary_en: UI component library for Design Engineers featuring 92+ copy-paste AI Agent patterns and 4 full-stack templates. Built with Tailwind CSS, fully Shadcn-compatible. Integrate via copy-paste, Next.js export, or v0 import for accessible, customizable interfaces.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill (Claude Code, Codex & more): Turn any script into animated stickman videos for faceless YouTube, Shorts & TikTok. 14+ styles with voiceover, captions & SFX. Free & open-source (MIT).
repos.summary_zh: Stickman Video Director是一款Codex Skill工具，利用Gemini Omni Flash将任意文案或创意转化为一分钟火柴人视频完整提示包。包含英文配音脚本、六场景导演计划及6个独立生产提示，支持9:16/16:9/1:1格式与明暗主题。核心亮点为故事架构优化、密集视觉隐喻与镜头运动规划、生产一致性锁定及源素材忠实性。适用于YouTube Shorts、TikTok、Instagram Reels等平台的教育短片、励志故事和视觉解说，通过对话式迭代审批提升短视频创作效率与连贯性。
repos.summary_en: Stickman Video Director is a Codex Skill that transforms any copy or idea into a complete one-minute stickman video prompt package using Gemini Omni Flash. It produces a confirmed English voiceover, a detailed six-scene director's proposal, and six standalone production-ready prompts. Supports 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 formats with light/dark themes. Key highlights include stronger story architecture, dense motion planning with metaphors and camera moves, production consistency locks across prompts, format-aware direction, and source fidelity. Ideal for educational shorts, motivational stories, and visual explainers on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube via conversational iterative approval.

repos.description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
repos.summary_zh: 赫蹏是专为中文网页内容设计的排版增强库，基于现代CSS与JavaScript实现。它提供网格对齐、中西文混排自动美化、标点挤压、竖排古文诗词版式等特性，支持简繁体与黑暗模式。通过简单的类名引入即可显著提升中文阅读体验，兼容主流样式重置方案，适配移动端。
repos.summary_en: Heti is a specialized typography enhancement library designed for Chinese web content presentation, implemented with modern CSS and JavaScript. It delivers grid-aligned layout, automatic Chinese-Western text spacing, punctuation compression, pre-configured layouts for classical texts and poetry, vertical writing support, and seamless dark mode adaptation. The library supports both simplified and traditional Chinese while being fully responsive for mobile devices. With simple class name integration, it dramatically elevates Chinese reading experience and is compatible with popular CSS reset solutions.

repos.description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
repos.summary_zh: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
repos.summary_en: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

repos.description: Handwriting animation for the web. Supports any font or text.
repos.summary_zh: Tegaki 是一个网页手写动画库，能将任意字体转化为自然的手写动画效果。无需手动路径绘制或原生依赖，支持 React、Vue、Svelte 等框架及多语言内置字体。适用于演示、教学、创意设计和视频制作场景，提供自定义字体生成和跨平台集成，技术实现纯 Web 且易于使用。
repos.summary_en: Tegaki is a powerful web library designed to transform any font into realistic animated handwriting effects. Without the need for manual path creation or native dependencies, it animates text stroke by stroke with natural timing. It provides seamless support for popular frameworks including React, Svelte, Vue, and SolidJS, along with built-in fonts covering multiple languages such as Latin, Arabic, Japanese, and Korean. This makes it perfect for use in presentations, educational materials, creative web designs, and programmatic video creation. Additionally, it includes tools for generating custom font bundles and easy cross-platform integrations.

repos.summary_zh: LiftKit是一个面向设计师的UI框架，通过数学公式自动实现设计最佳实践。核心提供缩放、间距和色彩的系统化解决方案，确保视觉对称、比例平衡和色彩平滑过渡。目前仅支持Next.js，正处于重写阶段以符合现代开发标准。项目由兼职维护者开发，暂不建议生产环境使用。其平台无关的设计系统可无缝集成到现代前端工作流中。
repos.summary_en: LiftKit is a UI framework for perfectionists that automatically enforces design best practices through mathematical formulas for scaling, spacing, and color. It ensures optical symmetry, balanced proportions, and smooth color ramps without manual effort. Currently Next.js-only, it's being rewritten with Base UI primitives to meet modern standards. The designer-built system is platform-agnostic and aims to make developers better designers. Maintained by part-time contributors, it's not production-ready yet but offers a robust foundation for design-system-driven development with community-driven expansion and Tailwind integration efforts.

repos.summary_zh: 为独立游戏开发者提供AI动画转精灵图的生产级管线。通过FFmpeg帧提取、自动去背景、智能打包成256x256标准格式，内置浏览器审查工具与AI助手集成，实现从AI生成视频到游戏可用资源的可控生产流程，确保仅审核通过的资产进入项目。
repos.summary_en: Provides indie game developers with a production-grade pipeline for converting AI-generated animations into sprite sheets. It extracts frames via FFmpeg, performs automatic matting, packs assets into standardized 256x256 formats, and includes a browser-based review tool with AI assistant integration, ensuring only approved outputs are promoted to game projects.

repos.summary_zh: 面向Svelte 5的精选生产级动效组件库，采用shadcn式copy-paste架构，通过CLI直接注入源码。封装GSAP与OGL，实现流畅WebGL与时间轴动画，覆盖磁力按钮、3D无限画廊等，专为实验性高性能网页设计打造。
repos.summary_en: Curated production-ready motion components for Svelte 5, using a shadcn-inspired copy-paste architecture via CLI. Wraps GSAP and OGL for smooth WebGL and timeline animations, including magnetic buttons and 3D galleries, focused on high-end experimental web motion design.

repos.description: Phantom-Motion is an incredibly powerful, epic interactive dynamic visual storytelling generator. Its capabilities are limited only by the bounds of your imagination! 它是一个极其硬核的史诗级交互式动态视觉叙事生成器。它的实力只取决于你的想象力高低！
repos.summary_zh: Phantom Motion 是一款基于 AI 的智能动态视觉叙事引擎，通过融合 GSAP 电影级运镜、Three.js GPGPU 粒子系统与 KaTeX 数学渲染，实现文本剧本到 60FPS 4K 商业视频的无缝转换。其 Audio-First 架构确保微秒级音画同步，Monocle 版式引擎与 WYSIWYG 交互套件支持所见即所得编辑，彻底革新传统影视制作流程。
repos.summary_en: Phantom Motion is an AI-powered dynamic visual storytelling engine that transforms text scripts into 60FPS 4K commercial videos. It integrates Hollywood-grade GSAP camera work, Three.js GPGPU particle systems, and KaTeX math rendering with Audio-First architecture for microsecond audio-visual sync. The Monocle layout engine and WYSIWYG editing suite revolutionize traditional video production workflows.
